case: sealed CAD, 15 deg tab, M1.2 (V 406.9 m/s, p 97690 Pa, T 286.2 K), fine mesh 1.5 M cells, local OpenFOAM only (SimScale could not hold M1.2)

steady_restart.solver: rhoSimpleFoam restart from M0.90_sealedcad_fine_opensides/2000, iteration ramp 305.0->406.9 m/s over 300, transonic True, consistent True, relax 'p=1,U=0.9,h=0.8,k=0.9,omega=0.9'
steady_restart.note: converged to 0.01 %; SIMPLEC steady state is not a fixed point of the transient: the transient relaxes away from it within 0.25 ms

transient.note: flat from 1.5 ms on; recommended M1.2 value

caveats: fixed-pressure side boundaries 0.6 m from the axis reflect the nose shock back onto the body ahead of the fins (domain artifact at M>1); axial force at M1.2 is therefore not trustworthy, roll moment is local to the tab and less affected
steady vs transient differ by 7 % on roll and 22 % on axial force -> treat the M1.2 roll as 1.79 N.m with ~+8 % upper bound
